statement: Bail should be made tougher for repeat violent offenders.

passages.title: Hansard 2025-10-28: Brodie (OneBC) debate
passages.quote: The Speaker : Shhh. Members, please. Hon. passages.title: OneBC — Home (mission & issue summaries)
passages.quote: Halt transfers, restore Band oversight, reform the Indian Act, restore English names, and end mandatory acknowledgements. Reconciliation Crack down on repeat and violent offenders and protect our ports from international criminal smuggling. Crime & Justice Remove SOGI-123 from classrooms, restore standardized testing in reading, writing and math, and institute a Parental Bill of Rights. Education Eliminate the Step Code raising costs with unnecessary green requirements and block rent control programs that disincentivize new housing development.
